title: Joshua 13
paragraphs: ¹ When Joshua was old and well advanced in years, the LORD said to him, You are now old, and a great deal of land still remains to be taken. ² This is what remains: all the regions of the Philistines and all of Geshur; ³ from the Shihor River east of Egypt northward to the border of Ekron, which is regarded as Canaanite territory — the five Philistine rulers of Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath, and Ekron, and also the Avvites; ⁴ to the south, all the land of the Canaanites, from Arah of the Sidonians as far as Aphek and the border of the Amorites; ⁵ and the region of Byblos, and all Lebanon to the east, from Baal Gad below Mount Hermon to Lebo Hamath.

⁶ I myself will drive out before the Israelites all the inhabitants of the mountain regions from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, including all the Sidonians. You are only to allot this land to Israel as an inheritance, as I have instructed you. ⁷ Now divide this land among the nine tribes and half the tribe of Manasseh as their inheritance. ⁸ The other half of Manasseh, along with the Reubenites and Gadites, had already received the inheritance Moses gave them east of the Jordan, just as Moses the servant of the LORD had assigned it to them. ⁹ It extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon gorge, including the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau of Medeba as far as Dibon; ¹⁰ and all the towns of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, out to the border of the Ammonites;

¹¹ and Gilead, and the territory of the Geshurites and Maacathites, all of Mount Hermon, and all of Bashan as far as Salecah — ¹² the entire kingdom of Og in Bashan, who had reigned in Ashtaroth and Edrei and was one of the last of the Rephaites. Moses had defeated them and taken over their land. ¹³ But the Israelites did not drive out the Geshurites and Maacathites, and they still live among the Israelites to this day. ¹⁴ Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi — their inheritance is the food offerings made to the LORD God of Israel, as he promised them. ¹⁵ Moses gave an inheritance to the tribe of Reuben according to its clans.

¹⁶ Their territory extended from Aroer on the rim of the Arnon gorge, including the town in the middle of the gorge, and the whole plateau as far as Medeba; ¹⁷ Heshbon and all its towns on the plateau — Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon, ¹⁸ Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath, ¹⁹ Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar on the hill in the valley, ²⁰ Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth —

²¹ all the towns of the plateau and the entire kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who had reigned in Heshbon. Moses had defeated him along with the Midianite chiefs Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, who were princes allied with Sihon and lived in the land. ²² Among those killed by the Israelites was Balaam son of Beor, the diviner, who was put to the sword. ²³ The Jordan formed the western boundary of the Reubenites. These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Reubenites by their clans. ²⁴ Moses also gave an inheritance to the tribe of Gad according to its clans. ²⁵ Their territory included Jazer, all the towns of Gilead, and half the land of the Ammonites as far as Aroer near Rabbah;

²⁶ and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpah and Betonim, and from Mahanaim to the territory of Debir; ²⁷ and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon — the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon. The Jordan formed the boundary along the eastern shore of the Sea of Kinnereth. ²⁸ These towns and their villages were the inheritance of the Gadites by their clans. ²⁹ Moses also gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh — this was the possession of half the tribe of Manasseh by their clans. ³⁰ Their territory extended from Mahanaim through all of Bashan — the entire kingdom of Og king of Bashan — including all sixty towns of Jair in Bashan;

³¹ and half of Gilead, and Ashtaroth and Edrei, the royal cities of Og in Bashan, were given to the descendants of Machir son of Manasseh — to half the descendants of Machir by their clans. ³² These are the territories Moses had distributed as inheritances on the plains of Moab, east of the Jordan across from Jericho. ³³ But Moses gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi; the LORD God of Israel is their inheritance, as he had promised them.
